The '''Starfront Health Corporation''' was a company that operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They manufactured the [[M3-M1 Medical Droid]].
